Buyer's briefing note - stretch film supply, 20 October.

Polywrap Films is our only qualified supplier of the 23-micron stretch film used on all four pallet wrappers. Qualifying a new supplier takes about four months (trials plus customer sign-off). We use roughly 9 tonnes a month.

On 15 October Polywrap sent a letter announcing a 14% price increase effective 1 November, citing "sharply higher resin costs". Our contract (clause 6.2) allows price changes only with at least 60 days' written notice and must be supported by a published raw-material index. The resin index named in the contract rose 6% between June and September. Polywrap's letter attached no index data.

Their account manager added on the phone that they "may need to prioritise customers on current pricing" if we push back. We hold about three weeks of film in stock. Last year's spend with Polywrap was about 410,000.

state: Incident note, Saturday 24 Oct, 11:30. Brightloom's autumn code FALL15 was meant to give 15% off orders over £60 on full-price home textiles. It went live at 08:00 on the site banner and in an email to 48,000 subscribers. A setup error left out the £60 minimum and let the code stack with the existing 20% clearance discount, so clearance items are going out at 35% off.
